sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting comfortably at the top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, will host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in excellent form with a recent run of W-D-W-W-W, while Alsager Town are struggling near the bottom with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six matches. This should be a straightforward encounter for Sandbach as they look to extend their unbeaten streak.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a crucial away trip to Dawley Town, with just 2 points separating the top two; Stafford's recent draw suggests inconsistency, while Dawley are mid-table. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the standings, host Eccleshall in a close matchup, though Bridgnorth's recent loss to Wolverhampton Casuals (who also travel away to face Wednesfield Community) may have dented their momentum. In other notable contests, Foley Meir entertain fifth-place Bilston Town—a significant test for the mid-table Foley side—and New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a lower-half duel. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's bottom club with just 2 points and no wins from 7 games; Crewe visit Allscott Heath in another struggling-side encounter; Shawbury United are at home to Barnton; and Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town, a pair of sides battling near the relegation zone.
